# Pranjal Sarkar

> Pranjal Sarkar is a product leader, 3x founder, author and speaker. His work focuses on product leadership, decision making, AI and work, career decisions and leadership. He is the creator of the Decision Audit Gap framework.

## About

- [Pranjal Sarkar](https://pranjalsarkar.com/): Official website of Pranjal Sarkar, covering his professional experience, frameworks, workshops, speaking and resources.

## Decision Audit Gap

- [Decision Audit Gap](https://pranjalsarkar.com/): Pranjal Sarkar's original framework for helping professionals and organizations examine important decisions before focusing on execution.

## Decision Audit Tools

- [Role Safety Audit](https://pranjalsarkar.com/tools/a1/ps-role-safety.html): A structured audit that examines task substitutability, AI complementarity and structural protection around a professional role.

## Speaking & Lectures

- [Lectures & Talks](https://pranjalsarkar.com/lectures-talks/): Pranjal Sarkar's university lectures, corporate sessions, industry events and speaking engagements.

## Website

- [Home](https://pranjalsarkar.com/): Official website containing information about Pranjal Sarkar's product leadership, Decision Audit Gap framework, tools, workshops, book and insights.
